select id,name,code,disabled,approve_status from ( select cb.id,cb.name,cb.code,cb.disabled,cb.approve_status from customer_b2c cb where cb.is_deleted = false
and ((cb.code = #{params.searchKeyword}) or (cb.id = #{params.searchKeyword}) or cb.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
order by
case when cb.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when cb.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when cb.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , cb.name,
cb.disabled asc ) cbc
